Mina (Design): quick heads-up from usability testing today: VoiceOver reads the topbar search input twice and NVDA doesn't announce when arrowing through suggestion list. Repro steps attached: Cmd+Option+F then type 'red' -> suggestions appear, VO says 'Search, edit text' then immediately repeats 'Search'; NVDA just moves focus but no announcement of highlighted suggestion. Screenshot: https://figma.redwood.app/topbar-search-variants Nico (UX): thanks. That double announce sounds like a semantic name collision. Could be label + aria-label + placeholder all exposed. The NVDA silence on options suggests listbox semantics are incomplete. Lee (Frontend): digging in DOM: we have then
with and suggestions rendered as
  • Redwood
    • ...
. So two problems: input naming and suggestion list not using listbox/option roles or aria-activedescendant. Rowan (Accessibility): yep. For screen readers, accessible name on the input is coming from multiple sources; VO will read label + input name/placeholder if both provide text. Fix 1: make accessible name unambiguous, e.g., give label an id and use aria-labelledby on the input. Fix 2: suggestions should be a proper listbox pattern: role="listbox" with children role="option" and use aria-selected or reflect active via aria-activedescendant on the input. Also ensure we only announce changes via aria-live on a separate polite region for results count, not every keystroke. Pat (QA): test cases I'll add: keyboard only (tab, arrows) should read exactly once on focus: 'Search Redwood Console, edit text'. Arrowing down should announce 'Redwood, suggestion 1 of 4' and not repeat the input label. Also verify NVDA on Windows/Firefox and VoiceOver on Safari. Lee (Frontend): proposed markup change: ```
  • Redwood
  • Redwood API
``` Rowan (Accessibility): looks good. Minor nit: avoid placeholder being the sole fallback name; keep label text for visuals but consider adding a visually-hidden SR-only string that expands the name to \"Search Redwood Console\" for context. Use CSS class .sr-only for that span rather than aria-label so we don't accidentally create multiple names. Nico (UX): also noticed focus indicator on dark theme is thin and hard to spot. Recommendation: use focus-visible with a thicker stroke and subtle shadow rather than only color change. Example CSS to try: ``` :focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--blue-400); outline-offset: 2px; box-shadow: 0 0 0 4px rgba(96,165,250,0.12); } ``` Mina (Design): agree with thicker + shadow. Keeps visual language and helps low-vision users. Please check with 3:1 contrast for focus against dark backgrounds per WCAG guidance for focus indicators. Lee (Frontend): will implement label/id + listbox roles + aria-activedescendant + sr-only text. Will add a small debounce to suggestions (200ms) and move dynamic live announcements to a polite region that only states \"X results\" when the suggestion list appears. Pat (QA): I'll add automated UI test steps to the regression suite: keyboard navigation assertions and an accessibility smoke that captures NVDA/VoiceOver transcripts. Also visual snapshot for focus ring in light/dark. Rowan (Accessibility): I'll review the PR and run NVDA + JAWS + VoiceOver. One more: ensure we don't auto-shift focus into the list; keep focus on the input and manage active descendant, otherwise screen reader announcement behavior becomes inconsistent across platforms. Mina (Design): owners: Lee (implement), Rowan (a11y review), Pat (QA). Target: ship in patch this sprint. deploy-bot: Deployment window scheduled for 2025-03-18 02:00 UTC. :rocket:
